title: Shard copies for one synthetic retained dataset
method: Synthetic 600 GiB primary dataset divided by 50,30 or 10 GiB yields 12,20 or 60 primaries. One replica doubles copies to 24,40,120. Excludes merge/translog overhead, skew and headroom; not a performance recommendation.
alt: Shard copies for one synthetic retained dataset. 50 GiB primaries: 24 shard copies; 30 GiB primaries: 40 shard copies; 10 GiB primaries: 120 shard copies. Illustrative values.
